newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Republic Cement 3-mth net at 45.375 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Republic Cement 3-mth net at 45.375 mln pesos.

text.p: Republic Cement Corp said on Tuesday it net income for the three months ended December 31, 1996 was at 45.375 million pesos compared with 23.861 million pesos in the same period a year ago.

Based on unaudited figures submitted by Republic Cement to the Securities and Exchange Commission, net sales rose to 415.758 million pesos in October-December 1996 from 317.915 million pesos in the year-ago quarter.
Cost of sales was likewise higher at 328.889 million from 253.604 million pesos.
Operating expenses also increased to 22.0 million from 16.9 million pesos, Republic Cement reported.
